title: Data Mapper
text: 将整数符号从一种编码方案映射到另一种编码方案，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Mapping mode} 指定映射模式 Binary to；{Symbol set size (M)} 指定符号集大小、{Mapping vector} 指定将输入元素映射到输出元素，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | column vector | matrix

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出信号 scalar | column vector | matrix

params.name: Mapping mode
params.values: 映射模式 Binary to Gray (default) | Gray to Binary | User Defined | Straight through

params.name: Mapping vector
params.values: 将输入元素映射到输出元素 [0 1 3 2 7 6 4 5] (default) | vector
